programme.title: 小心睇後: 大追捕
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong celebrity is found brutally murdered, detective Lam is called in to take charge. But the more that Lam pursues his suspect, the deeper he falls into a web of lies.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -歡度今晚夜
programme.desc: In this episode, “Night King” Dayo Wong and Director Jack Ng reveal their personal experiences in nightclubs. While Dayo shares his 'bitterness' of being surrounded by the ladies and unveils the intricate storylines in the film, they also discuss about the differences between “Night King” and previous nightclub movies, allowing everyone to appreciate the film from various perspectives.

programme.title: LAST MILE：全面引爆
programme.desc: On the day before the Black Friday sale, a box delivered by a global e-commerce company, explodes. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web.

programme.title: 風暴
programme.desc: A hardboiled senior police inspector Lui, hot on the trails of a seasoned criminal Nam and his tight crew, determines to put an end to this madness..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -信者得愛
programme.desc: Sandra Ng reveals how her admiration for MC (Cheung Tin Fu) has initiated their May-December romance in the film “Love Lies”! During the interview, Sandra not only praises this new generation actor and also recalls the time they spent together in Sapporo. Let's find out how Sandra talks about her interpretation of the lonely, strong woman in the drama, showing everyone a different side of herself.

programme.title: 12金鴨
programme.desc: Devastated by a love affair, former in-demand gigolo Future Chang retreats to Thailand. Thanks to the intervention of his high school teacher, Future summons the courage to return..

programme.title: 4拍4家族
programme.desc: “Band Four” is the story of Cat aspiring to make her mark on the global music stage, while contending with the haunting absence of her father, King, a guitarist who abandoned her and her mother two decades ago. Cat's life takes a dramatic turn when her mother succumbs to illness, and King unexpectedly appears at the funeral together with Matilda, Cat's previously unknown adolescent stepsister, further complicating Cat's ongoing struggle to raise her own 9-year-old son, Riley. Forced to live together in a crowded Hong Kong flat, the newly reunited family finds itself in a vortex of conflicting personalities, insecurities, and priorities. The family finds amidst this turmoil a common communication channel via music. Just as the familial bond begins to form through their shared musical language, both their bond and Band Four's survival are put to the test by a fresh set of unforeseen challenges.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 逆球大叔
programme.desc: Woo-jin's win rate as a coach is less than 10%! Dismissed, expelled, bankrupt, kicked out, divorced...Even in life, he's experiencing defeat after defeat. Then, Pink Storm, a pro volleyball team that is on the brink of disbanding, brings him on as their coach. Pink Storm's ace players have all transferred to another team, so it's currently a team of leftovers. Jung-won buys the team even though the players have no skills and no teamwork. Jung-won, who is obsessed with creating a heartwarming story of losers' growing pains, pledges to give away a total of $2 million if Pink Storm wins just once. Pink Storm becomes the center of attention, but they keep losing. Woo-jin is used to losing, but he still gets frustrated. Even though the players lack experience and potential, he starts to desire one win..

programme.title: 竊聽風雲3
programme.desc: Five Years ago, LAW was jailed for killing a major land owner in a car accident. At that time LAW worked as a chauffeur for the rural tycoon LUK. It was rumored that LUK was behind such land owner's death, which gave LUK a competitive edge in the native apartment development deal. Before the Hong Kong handover in 1997, every native, male resident in the New Territories was granted the right to build a house. Yet it had caused social unrest over the land right, until recently the government decided to gather all of the remaining land rights from these residents and plan to build taller apartment buildings. LUK wished to swallow the enormous project and this started the fights between LUK, the land owner and other real estate developers. When LAW gets out of prison five years later, the world has changed..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: Two perplexed middle-aged losers, Robby and Fai are good friends. Fai is honest man. His wife left him with an elderly home business. Fai has tried very hard to keep it running until the owner increases the rent crustily. Taxi driver Robby, who is timid and unreliable, he always neglected the conflicts between his mother and his wife. Robby always lives paycheck to paycheck without a financial plan, so he is at a loss what to do. There are two robberies involving the money exchange stores just across the street encourages Robby and Fai to get a gun and rob the same. It is a destiny to meet the ruthless bandit Mui, who acts wicked, scheming and chivalrous.

programme.title: 藉著雨點再愛你
programme.desc: Along with his young son, Ji-ho, Woo-jin misses his wife Soo-a, who died after promising to return a year later with the rainy season. Miraculously, they reunite with Soo-a when the rainy season comes around, but she has no memory of her husband and son whom she dearly loved.

programme.title: 我的情敵女婿
programme.desc: An ageing bachelor playboy finally meets the girl of his dreams and proposes marriage, only to discover her psychologist stepmom was his first love long ago. The future in-laws initially pretend not to know each other but as the wedding date gets nearer, the rekindling of long-dormant feelings develops into a cross-generational love triangle.

programme.title: 燈火闌珊
programme.desc: Widow Mei-heung has gone through countless sleepless nights since the death of her husband, Bill. One day, she finds a key among the items that Bill left behind, leading her to his secret neon workshop and his young apprentice, Leo. She learns from Leo that Bill had an unfulfilled last wish–to recreate a demolished legendary neon sign. With Leo's help, Mei-heung tries to uncover the story behind the sign and learns the craft of blowing neon lights in hopes of fulfilling her deceased husband's last wish with her own hands. Along the way, Mei-heung reminisces about her beautiful encounters with Bill and unearths pieces of Bill's past as if they are the last consolation left by him. Meanwhile, Mei-heung's daughter, Prism, plans to leave Hong Kong with her fiance, but she is unable to break the news to Mei-heung. As clues of the legendary neon sign gradually emerge, the secrets that Mei-heung couldn't face are about to be revealed..

programme.title: 好好拍電影
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Northeastern China, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalize.

programme.title: 小心睇後: 獵戰
programme.desc: After a high-ranking North Korean official requests asylum, KCIA Foreign Unit chief Park Pyong-ho (LEE Jung Jae) and Domestic Unit chief Kim Jung-do (JUNG Woo Sung) are tasked with uncovering a North Korean spy, known as Donglim, who is deeply embedded within their agency. When the spy begins leaking top secret intel that could jeopardize national security, the two units are each assigned to investigate each other. In this tense situation where if they cannot find the mole, they may be accused themselves, Pyong-ho and Jung-do slowly start to uncover the truth. In the end, they must deal with an unthinkable plot to assassinate the South Korean president..

programme.title: 失眠
programme.desc: During Japan's wartime occupation of Hong Kong in 1941-1945, a young translator's collaboration with the enemy results in his life being cursed by a murdered 'comfort woman' forced to become a sex slave. Forty-five years later, the man's sins come back to haunt his son, a professor specializing in sleeping disorders, when the lady's ghost returns for vengeance.

programme.title: 低一點的天空
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a nickname because of his chubby body, is a moderately mentally handicapped person. He works happily and passionately as a delivery boy in a restaurant. Little Cheung is a spastic with normal IQ working as an office boy. Fairy Snow White, name it after a renowned Chinese opera actress, is a blissful, middle-class daughter. Her bright future suddenly turned vague when she became blind at age twelve. From then on, she is living in the dark, but her childhood memories enable her to live in peace and harmony. Fat Cat, Little Cheung and Snow White become good friends afterwards, sharing their respective dream. They don't think it is feasible except Fat Cat does..

programme.title: 北京樂與路
programme.desc: Yang Yin, a starry-eyed dance girl in search of love; Ping Lu, an impetuous Beijing Rock and Roll singer in search of recognition; and Michael, a Hong Kong-born and overseas-educated composer in search of himself. Three people from different walks of life are..

programme.title: 黑道深淵
programme.desc: High school student Yeon-gyu lives in a nightmare, where he needs to endure the physical abuse from his alcoholic stepfather. His only goal is to save enough money and escape from the living hell with his mother. One day, he gets into a fight and receives help from Chi-geon, an enigmatic gangster in the town. While the relationship of the two gradually develops into a brotherhood, Chi-geon is getting deeper in the swamp.

programme.title: 超越
programme.desc: Tianyi Wu, a young 100-meter-running champion, returns to his hometown, aiming to get off his chest the failure to surpass his former teammate, Chaoyue Hao. But he doesn't expect to see that Chaoyue's life is in shambles as well. They retreat to the memories of their lives, both shared and separate, in an attempt to lift each other up from their current situation.

programme.title: 聖誕玫瑰
programme.desc: Tim is a defence attorney with a heart of gold. Refusing to be simply a hired gun for his clients, he quits his high-powered job to become a prosecutor for the Justice Department. With the support of fiancee Megan and cop buddy Nam, Tim decides to start afresh. When he meets a handicapped piano teacher, Jing, who urges him to help her. She is accusing her doctor, Zhou a renowned surgeon of sexual harassment during a routine check-up. But with no witnesses and only their own conflicting testimonies, a Rashomon-like mystery unfolds. To make matters worse, Zhou's defence attorney, Freddy, is Tim's successor at his old law firm, and proves to be Tim's toughest opponent to-date. As a media frenzy encircles the case, it slowly destroys the lives of everyone involved.

programme.title: 曾經擁有
programme.desc: Anyone who has anything to do with the film industry in Hong Kong, must have heard of a film buff called Lil' Kim. He knows everything there is to know about filmmaking. Whether it's on the set, at the movie premiere or at a press conference, he always shows up uninvited. Nobody knows where he came from and why he showed up... Ginger Keung is the producer of a reality show who suspects Lil' Kim is in fact a film critic who pans movies to extort advertising dollars from film companies. She zeroes in on Lil' Kim as her next target and decides to dig into his elusive past..

programme.title: 最後的怒放
programme.desc: Forty years after leaving Japan for a boxing career in the U.S. that never panned out, Jin returns to restart his life with his old boxing buddies. When hotheaded young boxer Shogo asks for Jin's help to get him back into the ring after an unfair loss, the two men decide to seize their final chance at glory.

programme.title: 大上海
programme.desc: It was 1917, China. CHENG was an innocent young man who worked in a grocery store and had no ambition, other than to be with his lovely neighbour, the Peking Opera student QIU. But a fateful night had changed Cheng's life forever, as he literally walked right in the affair between his lady boss and the chief of police. To hide this secret, the chief decided to throw Cheng into prison, accusing him of raping his lady boss. Desolated, Cheng met a cellmate MAO, who happened to have an escape plan. The duo broke out, and Cheng had no choice but to leave his life, and his dream girl behind..

programme.title: 非同凡響
programme.desc: Ms Tsui is a music teacher in a special education needs (SEN) school, who is not able to switch to a mainstream school due to stereotyping and labelling; Zoey is an underachiever from a Band 1 school, who is struggling for the coming public examination; Ka Ho is a rebellious teenager from a Band 3 school, who idles away his time and doesn't care about his handicapped little brother...Fate drives the three to take part in a musical they deem worthless for their own purposes, which turns out to be a journey of self-discovery towards their dreams and goals.

programme.title: 馬達．蓮娜
programme.desc: Early spring in the city of Macau. Mada (Louis Cheung), a divorced man in his 40's, is the strong and silent type. He lives in a dilapidated flat that's set for demolition. Suffering from a serious case of amnesia, Mada works the graveyard shift as a taxi driver to overcome the pain of his affliction. One night, Mada picks up Lena (Chrissie Chau), who works as a restaurant receptionist by day and a bar hostess by night. After a misunderstanding sparks spark their friendship, Mada becomes Lena's driver, picking her up before and after work. Lena's arrival finally brings some color into Mada's life; he even begins to think that he can finally move on from his divorce. Yet, Lena feels lonely in Macau; she's disliked by her colleagues, who all think that she is a ruthless, money-grubbing hustler for using her voluptuous figure to get special treatment. Lena knows Mada's feelings for her, but she, too, is hiding a past that she can't get over..

programme.title: 毒舌大狀
programme.desc: In a moment of irresponsible negligence, sharp-tongued barrister Adrian Lam mishandles a child abuse case and indirectly sentences the innocent Jolene Tsang to prison for 17 years. Falling from disgrace, Adrian decides to serve the public and defend the commoners, until an unlikely opportunity for appeal surfaces. Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit.

programme.title: 小心睇後: 堅如磐石
programme.desc: Su Jianming, the son of Deputy Mayor Zheng Gang of Jinjiang City, defies his father's counsel and attends a cunning dinner invitation from the wealthiest man in Jinjiang City, Li Zhitian. To his astonishment, he becomes an unwilling witness to a shocking incident where someone is coerced into thrusting their hand into a simmering hotpot. As past mysteries resurface, hidden factions from various quarters plot and scheme, employing intricate strategies, scrutiny, and suspicion. Amidst the web of conflicting desires, the pressing question remains: who will ultimately unveil the final mask.

programme.title: 迷城
programme.desc: When former cop-turned-bar owner T-man Kwok (Louis KOO) befriends a drunken woman at closing hours (TONG Liya), they soon find themselves targeted both by her former lover-a high-powered Hong Kong attorney-and the thugs (CHANG Hsiao-Chuan) he employs. Once Kwok's underachieving half-brother (Shawn YUE) and a suitcase full of tainted cash enter the picture, the chase turns deadly, with the brothers' tense family history coming to the surface as Kwok finds himself torn between the triads and his former police colleagues.

programme.title: 暴瘋語
programme.desc: Three years ago, FAN (LAU Ching Wan) had a schizophrenic breakdown and killed his wife (Michelle YE Xuan). He later attempted to commit suicide but was unsuccessful, and was eventually sentenced to rehabilitate in a psychiatric facility indefinitely. Dr. CHOW (HUANG Xiao Ming) is FAN's psychiatrist. He believes FAN is cured after 3-year treatment and is alone in opposition to all doctors' objections to discharge FAN. After releasing from the facility, FAN faces discrimination and misunderstanding and once again finds himself at the brink of collapse. One night, he mistakenly kills a drug addict on impulse. He is driven to despair and comes to Dr. CHOW for help.Having thought about it, Dr CHOW fears his career will be wrecked if it is uncovered and therefore helps FAN abscond. The concealment of the truth subtly snowballs into chaos as it triggers media criticism and attacks due to his missing murderous patient. In order to redeem himself, CHOW decides to cure FAN with a confi.

programme.title: 漫畫殺人狂
programme.desc: Reality and fiction clash in demented ways in this serial killer thriller by award-winning advertisement director Akira Nagai. Reuniting with Nagai after his maniacally fun performance in Teiichi: Battle of Supreme High, Japanese cinema's “It Boy”, Masaki Suda, reveals his dark side as Keigo, a talented illustrator who is way too nice to write a villain in his comics. After witnessing the death of a family at the hands of a terrifying murderer, Keigo draws the murderer into his comic 34 and ends up creating a runaway hit. Co-starring Shun Oguri as a police detective chasing the serial killer, Character is a hair-raising chiller packed with unpredictable twists.

programme.title: 手捲煙
programme.desc: Former Hong Kong Military Service Corps officer becomes caught in a triad manhunt when he takes in an ethnic South Asian man carrying a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live under the same roof, the two men transcend their cultural and racial differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: 人生轉運站
programme.desc: The great adventure stories of worn goods that build bridges between people from all walks of life, following a former baseball player, a sleepless student, a new hangman, an imprisoned gangster, and a mysterious father and daughter. Kwang-sung was once a rising baseball star but he is now a desperate man, cold, hungry, hunted by two hitmen. One day he receives a call from a little boy Jae-ha who asks him to sell his baseball jacket. Na-na is Jae-ha's English teacher who is trying to investigate a murder case that Kwang-sung must be involved. Ye-ji helps Kwang-sung's escape when she sells Min-hyuk a sleep-time controller. Her brother Soo-jung is a hangman who actually wants to be a rock star. Jae-ha's uncle Seok-ho visits a story hunter and his mysterious daughter to sell off his old bittersweet memories. When they are about to shake hands, Anna Karenina suddenly comes in. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exciting c.

programme.title: 困獸
programme.desc: The President of Gaming Association blacklisted Wa Sam Group from bidding of gaming concessions on the ground. This blacklisting triggered a series of retaliations from Wa Sam Group. Thus, the Anti-Triad Office immediately set up a special team lead by Lee Shui Ming and he called back Man Fung for help. Fourth Elder's wife Chu Lei received a phone call from her ex-boyfriend Man Fung for a meeting. Kwan Chit, a member of the Gaming Association with the support of Wa Sam Group, also persuaded Man Fung to stop keeping his eyes on them. The two have parted in discord. Kwan Chit remembered the tragic death of his ex-girlfriend Man Kei, sister of Man Fung. He came to Man Fung late at night, the two old friends finally agreed to revenge for their beloved one together.

programme.title: 太太，請小心輕放劇場版
programme.desc: Haruka Ayase plays a newlywed wife who hides her past as a secret agent and beats up one bad guy after another like an action star. The identity of her husband (an agent of the Public Security Bureau) played by Hidetoshi Nishijima is gradually disclosed through a thrilling plot development. This story about a husband and wife who lie to each other but love each other nonetheless garnered attention.

programme.title: 分手的決心
programme.desc: Kind and polite detective Haejun is entrusted with a case of unnatural death in the mountains. While investigating the case, he meets Seorae, the dead victim's wife, and can't help but both suspect and develop an interest in her.

programme.title: 聽見兩個世界
programme.desc: Dai is born to deaf parents and has been raised with deep love in rural Japan. However, as he grows older, he becomes troubled by his differences from others and begins to blame his deaf mother for his daily frustrations. When he turns 20, Dai leaves home for Tokyo as if to escape. Life in Tokyo was lonely at first, but when Dai starts working as a magazine reporter, he finds fulfillment in meeting a diverse group of people. Time eventually passes, and Dai returns home for the first time in eight years. In spending peaceful time with his deaf mother after a long time, a memory that has been sealed away unexpectedly comes back to Dai.

programme.title: 飯戲攻心2
programme.desc: Belief in our own blessings can bring us good fortune, but what is true fortune? Fortune and misfortune, love and hate, what is their ultimate definitions? One family, three couples, three weddings. After they decided to move on, what further challenges await them? Marriage isn't just about two individuals; it involves a whole family of aunts, uncles, and cousins. Sunny Chan, with his unique sense of humor, once again dives into the complex dynamics of modern society's men and women, families and romance.

programme.title: 香港四徑大步走
programme.desc: At the time, they said it couldn't be done. In 2012, Andre Blumberg set off by himself, to run all four of Hong Kong's iconic ultra distance trails in just four days. 298km and over 14,500m of climbing later, one of the hardest ultra marathons in the world - the Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge - was born. With the 2021 edition of the challenge as the backdrop, 'Four Trails' takes you on a journey from when the concept was first was conceived to it's current format. Under 60 hours to be deemed a 'Finisher' and under 72 hours to be a ‘Survivor', unsupported and with an ever evolving set of rules. It takes a deep dive into the famous four trails that make up the challenge and you will both laugh and cry as the astonishing stories of those who dare attempt such a feat unfold.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 小心睇後: 屍蹤
programme.desc: Entering the houses with the key entrusted to him by the clients, 'Koo Jung-tae', a real estate agent with a hobby of spying on other people's lives. He becomes intrigued by SNS influencer 'Han Sora'. She posts a photo of a vegan salad while actually eating convenience store sausage, prompting him to begin spying on her closely. ‘Koo Jung-tae', eventually sneaks into ‘Han Sora's house, discovers her lifeless body on the sofa. Soon after, he starts receiving threats from someone who knows he was there. As homicide detective 'Oh Young-joo's investigation closes in on him, ‘Koo Jung-tae' is compelled to search for the real culprit using clues from 'Han Sora's social media and the people around her.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: The foreign migrant communities in Tokyo live shadowy lives. The Japanese neither acknowledge nor welcome them. They are shunned by the mainstream society, hounded by the yakuza, and go about their days under fear of being discovered and repatriated. It is an alien world for Steelhead – an honest, hardworking tractor repairman. Steelhead had decided to take the perilous journey to Tokyo after he lost contact with his girlfriend, who had arrived in the city earlier.

programme.title: 投名狀
programme.desc: In the fall of 1870, General Pang stands high atop the city walls fully attired in governor's robes. Peering down upon the site of his inauguration, he is filled with dreams and ambition. Pang has taken a path of no return; had he chosen differently, he might have been one of the heroes to later overthrow the corrupt Qing imperial regime and establish a new China. He could have changed the course of history. But two bandits and a woman have changed the course of his life, helping him achieve his goal, but ultimately causing his demise. The two bandits are his sworn blood brothers: Zhao Er-Hu and Jiang Wu-Yang..

programme.title: Laughing Gor之變節
programme.desc: Brother Laughing is supposedly an undercover police officer who has infiltrated a triad organization. During a drug-trafficking operation he is caused by Superintendent Poon. Before he became a police officer, Brother Laughing was a member of the triads and worked for the big boss man No. 1. No. 1 was very good to Laughing, and Laughing looked up to No. 1 as his elder brother. In order to strengthen his business and illegal activities, No. 1 arranges for Laughing to join the Police Force and become his mole to gather information about the plans and counter-plans for operations by the police. Laughing graduated from Police Academy with outstanding results but before he was assigned to a post as a police officer, his “bad boy” image attracted the attention of the Head of District Anti-Triad Squad, Superintendent Sin who arranges his assignment as an undercover cop to infiltrate the mob syndicate. Laughing was now a “double” mole. No. 1 was happy with this turn of events as Laug.

programme.title: 北京遇上西雅圖之不二情書
programme.desc: Jiao Ye moved to Macau with her father when she was 15. She is a sassy casino worker who longs for love, but her life was hard. Daniel, a commitment-averse real estate agent in Los Angeles who specializes in selling properties to wealthy Chinese and father of a teenage son. Love blooms between the two as they start exchanging letters because of a book, they sharing their most personal and intimate self with each other.

programme.title: 24小時救參行動
programme.desc: A group of Korean tourists is taken hostage by an extremist Taliban group in Afghanistan. The Korean government dispatches Jae-ho, known as one of Korea's most skilled diplomats, in order to handle the situation. Once he arrives, he asks for the Afghan government's cooperation and uses every means possible to free the hostages. However, his efforts go in vain. Due to his failure, he's forced to work with Dae-sik, a special agent who is an expert on the Middle East. As they begin making their move to get to the Taliban, the first hostage death occurs. With nowhere else to turn, the two become unlikely allies in a race against time to save the rest of the hostages.

programme.title: 鐵道英雄
programme.desc: Winter in 1939, southern Shandong Province, railway workers Hong and Wang led a guerrilla force active on the railway line. In a snowy night, Hong led a group of people, including Qi Lu and Lin Dong, to assassinate three senior Japanese officials, which enraged the Japanese army. Fujiwara, a senior Japanese agent, arrived discreetly and had initiated an investigation. The railway squad and Fujiwara went head-to-head with rounds of hard battles, during which the railway squad sacrificed three members and Wang's undercover identity was revealed. At this time, a train carrying crucial Japanese armaments was about to pass by, and the railway crew members chose to step up and fight the enemy to the death at this vital juncture.

programme.title: 飛翔吧﹗埼玉2
programme.desc: A live-action film adaptation of Mineo Maya's “Fly Me to the Saitama” turned out to be a huge, unexpected box office hit of 2019. With the producers who took the demand for a sequel as real, the cast and crew got back together to complete the second chapter of the urban legend in Fly Me To The Saitama -FROM BIWA LAKE WITH LOVE-. In addition to the biting yet affectionate dissing of Saitama and the Kanto region in the first film, the sequel contains an even more scathing dissing of the Kansai region. Alongside costars GACKT and Fumi Nikaido, Ryo Kato and Tsubasa Masuwaka reprise their roles as members of the Saitama Liberation Front. A crucial protagonist who joins their battle, Kai Kikyo, the handsome leader of the Shiga Liberation Front, is played by Anne in her first role as male character. Akira Kashoji, the ruthless governor of Osaka and kingpin of the Kansai region who stands in the way of Rei and others, is played by Ainosuke Kataoka. In addition to Norika Fujiwara and.

programme.title: 你好，之華
programme.desc: There are fidgety encounters, like there are uncomplicated goodbyes. All Yuan Zhinan left behind on the morning of her departure from the world was a letter and an invitation to a school reunion. Attending the reunion in lieu of her late elder sister, Zhihua accidentally ran into Yin Chuan, her crush of her youth. As old memories are evoked to a present time of reshuffled relationships, as correspondences travel through different contexts and times, Zhihua slowly uncovers the intricate story among the trio.

programme.title: 欺詐女王
programme.desc: Ji-hye is a once-successful and beautiful swindler, who recently begins failing with her cons and dreams of changing her small-job life. Before her retirement, she decides to take on one last job which could change her whole life: seducing the son of a wealthy art broker family to steal the golden treasure hidden in their secret mansion. With the help of her daughter Ju-young, she succeeds in earning the trust of the family but it turns out to be a never-ending battle. Can Ji-hye and Ju-young find the legendary treasure and start a new life.

programme.title: 歡迎來到駒田蒸餾所
programme.desc: Kotaro, a novice editor for a web news, visits Komada Distillery for a project on Japanese craft whisky. Led by a young female president Rui who recently took over the family business, the distillery works hard to reproduce its signature whisky KOMA they had to stop making years ago. KOMA was a brand that Rui's family had lovingly preserved over generations and a symbol of happiness for all. However, not to mention financial backing, too many clues are missing to revive the whisky once lost. Rui, Kotaro, and the distillery supporters pull together every thread to bring back the whisky filled with family memories.

programme.title: 從今以後
programme.desc: Angie and Pat are a lesbian couple who have been together for over four decades. Pat bought an apartment over thirty years ago where they have lived ever since. The couple is open to their families and often invites Pat's family to their home for dinners. Angie's relationship with them has always been very close. When Pat passes away unexpectedly, Angie is suddenly left on her own to deal with matters related to Pat and her estate. It is not too long before a clash develops over their opinions about the burial arrangements. Angie begins to feel increasingly alienated from Pat's family..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -「港」笑研究所
programme.desc: Hong Kong comedies from the 1980's and 1990's had been widely popular and many of them are still considered as classics among the genre. In this episode, the “Humor Research Institute” has invited veteran filmmakers Chan Hing Kai, Ho Miu Ki and Jack Ng to talk about their comedy-creating experience and introduce how fascinating comedies are written.

programme.title: 小心睇後: 潛行
programme.desc: In the new century, the fight against drugs faces an unprecedented and difficult challenge! Under the deep and complex dark network, an invisible war is being waged in Hong Kong...... Typhoon signal was hoisted in Hong Kong. Under the cover of the fierce wind, four tons of methamphetamine were entering Hong Kong, pending to be sold on the dark network. A cyber revelry of druggies was about to be unveiled, and a storm was brewing in the quiet Victoria Harbour. Police had to arrest the “boss” behind the scenes and nip the “drug network” in the bud in no time, that pushed their undercover intelligence to the narrow road. In the center of the storm, undercover agents, police officers, drug lords, black, white, and gray entangled.

programme.title: 破墓
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, the renowned shaman Hwa-rim and her protege Bong-gil are commissioned with a hefty sum to meet the enigmatic descendants of a household afflicted by a peculiar illness. Sensing the ominous aura surrounding the ancestral grave, Hwa-rim urges for its relocation. The best geomancer in the business, Sang-duk, and mortician Young-geun, lured by the scent of money, join the team. The mysterious grave, situated in an unapproachable sacred ground, holds dark secrets. Though Sang-duk senses an ominous presence and initially rejects the proposal, Hwa-rim's persuasion ultimately initiates the exhumation, leading to a journey where the team must confront both supernatural forces and their own fears.

programme.title: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: 東京復仇者2 血腥萬聖節篇–命運
programme.desc: “I'll save you! Over and over! I'll never give up until I find a future where you're still alive!” Takemichi thought he had saved his ex-girlfriend Hinata...but once again, she was killed by the Tokyo Manji Gang, an organization that had grown violent and corrupt. This time, she was killed right in front of his eyes... The key to saving Hinata was linked to a tragic event that had torn apart the six founding members of Tokyo Manji... Six best friends who swore to die for one another. Why did they turn against each other? The epic battle on Halloween, October 31, would pit best friends against each other and threaten to destroy the Tokyo Manji Gang.

programme.title: 東京復仇者2 血腥萬聖節篇–決戰
programme.desc: The intense battle between former friends, which poses a threat to the collapse of Tokyo Manji Gang, has finally begun. Mikey sets out to bring back Baji, who has defected to the enemy, Valhalla. Kazutora, who remains with Valhalla, aims to crush Tokyo Manji Gang and kill Mikey. The tragic past that tore apart the founding members of Tokyo Manji Gang and broke the bonds between the former comrades comes to light. 'I don't want anyone else to die!' Embracing their respective convictions, will Takemichi be able to prevent the worst outcome and create a brighter future? And can he once again save Hinata and the future of his friends.

programme.title: 繼續爭氣
programme.desc: In 2013, My Voice, My Life followed classes of students from three high schools for underprivileged kids and one school for the visually impaired as they embarked on a voyage of self-discovery through taking part in a musical production. Six years later, what kinds of lives are they leading now? My Voice, My Life Revisited goes in search of four of those students: Ah Bok, Coby, Sio Fan and Tsz Nok, charting their transformation and how they have grown over these past few years, as well as the challenges they are facing today.

programme.title: 特工爺爺
programme.desc: Bodyguard, The follows a retired bodyguard (Hung) who has settled in the dark and unknown corner of the world where China, Russia and North Korea meet. Suffering from the beginnings of dementia, Bodyguard, The is befriended by a young girl whose life is threatened when her father (Lau) falls in with the local crime world. When the girl and her father disappear, Bodyguard, The must call upon his long forgotten skills to save the life of his young friend.

programme.title: 午夜天鵝
programme.desc: Nagisa is transgender. She grew up in Hiroshima as a man, but now lives in Shinjuku, Tokyo as a woman. Due to an incident, she begins to live with middle school student Ichika, who is a distant relative. Ichika has been neglected by her mother Saori. From living in solitude by herself, to now living with Ichika, Nagisa develops maternal instincts for the first time.

programme.title: 寒戰
programme.desc: Approaching midnight in Hong Kong, police headquarters receives an anonymous call: a police van carrying the advanced equipment and five officers has disappeared off the grid..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：梁家輝: 寒戰2
programme.desc: The story of this highly-anticipated sequel continues as Acting Police Commissioner Sean Lau (Aaron Kwok) is promoted to the highest rank in the police force. Joe (Eddie Peng Yuyan), son of Deputy Police Commissioner Waise Lee (Tony Leung Ka Fai) who is behind the conspiracy, is taken into custody and Waise is forced to retire. But Master, Themind remains unknown, until the resurface of a former police chief who unveils an unprecedented scheme to corrupt the police force. Things get more complicated when senior counsel Oswald Kan (Chow Yun Fat) leads an impeachment proceeding against Sean. Oswald's every decision is pivotal in determining who stays on top of the game.

programme.title: 妃子笑
programme.desc: In the ancient Chinese dynasties, there were thousands concubines but only one Princess in the palace. To be the only one, girls fought by all means. Two beauties, Mandy came from poor family and Pearl came from aristocracy. They became soul mates and swore they were friends forever and would help each other on the way to the Princess Selection. But they discovered that there was only one girl could be the Princess, and things became different. To execute the enemies, to strive for the throne and the luxury life, girls bribed, rigged, poisoned and framed each other. They ever knew the cost for the throne was far beyond their expectation..

programme.title: 男航女機師
programme.desc: HAN Jung-woo, a pilot with top-class skills, is flying high and even appears on a famous TV show. But everything comes crashing down when a careless mistake causes him to lose everything, even his job. Blacklisted in the industry, no airline is willing to hire him. Desperate with no other choice, HAN Jung-woo transforms completely into his younger sister's identity and succeeds in landing a job as a pilot. But soon, he encounters more unexpected problems... Will his dream of cruising through life ever take off.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -情陷「網」中人
programme.desc: Sandra Ng and MC (Cheung Tin Fu) grow a virtual romance in the film “Love Lies” which the script has revolved around online dating scam. What inspired the production team to make such a tale of love and deceit? And how the main cast of two initially unlikable people was chosen? The film director Ho Miu Ki and producer Chan Hing Kai are invited hereby to tell us more about this romantic comedy..

programme.title: 我談的那場戀愛
programme.desc: 'Love, once believed, is real.' Despite being swindled out of a large sum of money, the well-known gynecologist Yu still insisted that she was in love. Yu, who had been widowed for several years, met Joe, who was disguised as a middle-aged French petroleum engineer and widower, on a dating app, not knowing that he was part of an online scam group. Not only was Yu immersed in the online romance, but Joe also found pleasure and satisfaction in creating romantic experiences for Yu. Two initially unlikable people gradually changed through this online romance that began with deception.

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播：爆谷一世好戲: 捕風追影
programme.desc: A crew of criminal prodigies disappears with billions, evading capture by outsmarting the formidable “Sky Eye” surveillance system. Desperate and outmaneuvered, the Macau police enlist the help of a legend-Wong Tak-Chung, a retired tracking expert. He mentors rookie officer He Qiuguo and rebuilds an elite surveillance unit. Their mission: to track down the elusive “Wolf King,” Fu Longsheng, the mastermind behind the heist. As the police close in, the thieves spring a trap of their own. Brains clash, loyalties are tested, and the ultimate cat-and-mouse game is about to begin..

programme.title: 西遊記之月光寶盒
programme.desc: At the foothills of Fingers Mountain, there is one Highwaymen's Haven, operating as a motel. The gang leader is a fellow named The Joker, and the gang makes a living out of robbing the traveling businessmen and scholars. The Joker is in fact Monkey King reincarnated. Grandpa Buddha is the only God who knows about this. Two of the devils, Spider Woman and Boney M, took the guise of Sharon Stone and Madonna and wooed him into betraying this secret. The two devils decided to get the Joker out of the way so that they could capture the Longevity Monk when the time came for his reincarnation..

programme.title: 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.title: 龍的心
programme.desc: It's the two brothers of Hong Kong action as you have never seen them before in a gripping drama where the lines blur between family loyalty and upholding the law. Jackie Chan plays Ted, a SWAT officer with thwarted dreams of being a sailor because he has to look after his mentally disabled brother Danny. The resentment boils over in a terse showdown between the two brothers. When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him.

programme.title: 影人映語 -洪家班靠「搏」出位 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: In the last episode, Sammo Hung shared his story of being an action-choreographer, director and actor for over half a century in the film industry. Now he is going to talk more about apprenticeship with his master Yu Jim-yuen whom he learned the martial arts philosophy from and his journey of growing next-generation action stars; also give us an insight into the challenges towards Hong Kong action film nowadays.

programme.title: 星願
programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive.

programme.title: 花心夢裏人
programme.desc: Fat Chiu and Frankie live together on a temporary basis. During their stay at home, they spend time with one of the home-mate Kwan and consequently build up very close relationship. Sally, who is Frankie's girlfriend, is deeply in romance with Frankie. However, when Pauline, a billionaire turns up, Frankie is crazily attracted by her. He decides to give up Sally. On the other hand, Fat Chiu immediately proceeds his plan and shows his care and love to Sally. Although Sally is so touched of the sincerity of Fat Chiu and accepts his offer, she knows she still loves Frankie. Kwan opines that Sally is damaging female dignity. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire..

programme.title: BB30
programme.desc: Bau is a poor lawyer who has never won in litigation. He is a righteous guy but his unstable character brings him under disciplinary investigation, during which he meets a beautiful doctor, Cheng. However, since Cheng often deposes against Bau, misunderstanding and conflict grow between the two. On the other hand, Susan, an aerobic dancing instructor, has a deep passion for Bau for a long time and this makes Mo feel jealous and determine to go against him. As Bau and Mo go together, troubles and laughers are stirred up..

programme.title: 逃學威龍
programme.desc: A member of the Flying Tiger Squad, Sing, is sent to school as an undercover cop to find the Commissioner's lost gun. To Sing, school is nowhere better than jail. He is suffering until he comes across the school teacher Miss Ho. Sing's school life is thus painted with more colours. Finally, Sing settles every problem and succeeds in finding the lost gun. At the Same Time, he destorys a munition smuggling activity. This leads the smugglers to school to take revenge. A group of students is being kept hostage. Sing shows his true colour by saving all the students. This not only wins his students' admiration but also Miss Ho's heart.

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 老豆唔怕多
programme.desc: As with any other child of his age, seven-years-old Benny takes delight in getting into mischief and is a constant headache to his teachers and classmates. One day, his naughty ways finally led him into serious trouble. A list of triad members has fallen into his hands and he was kidnapped by the notorious gangsters. Thinking it was one of his usual pranks, his dad was undisturbed by Benny's sudden disappearance and made no attempt to trace his whereabouts. However, providence is on Benny's side for a policeman and a reporter are hot pursuit of him, as they both believed Benny to be their son..

programme.title: 女黑俠黃鶯
programme.desc: Wong Ngung wants to help her adoptive father Yip Lei-yam to eradicate Lui Pao, an evildoer in the gang. But Lui Pao forestalls them; Yip and his daughter Mocking Bird are killed, and Wong loses her memory by a big hit. A sorceress and a girl Ah Ching save her. The two women think that Wong is a rich girl, so they treat her very well and hope for repayment. Ah Ching is in love with Ah Kat, a car-repairing worker. Her mother opposes it. Her mother also bears a great debt because of gambling.

programme.title: 流氓醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.

programme.title: 跛豪
programme.desc: The story of Ho, a chinese peasant/slave worker who escapes to Hong Kong and becomes one of the most feared crime bosses in Hong Kong.

programme.title: 鐵妹
programme.desc: The Story is set in the period during the Japanese invasion of China in the 1930's. A Chinese traitor Tung working within the puppet state of Manchukuo, gets involved in an affair with the mistress of a military officer. Their affair is exposed and in the confusion, Tung kills the officer and has to flee from the Japanese. In the desolate arid lands, his life is saved by Iron Sister, a member of guerrillas from a nearby hunting village, whom has an affair later with Tung. The humble villagers are very simple minded and only wished to drive out the Japanese. They fall easy prey, as Tung disguises his real identity and continues his secret contacts with his collaborators. One by one, the villagers become victims of Tung's ploy. Accidentally his plot is discovered by Iron Sister and they engage in a battle of life and death.

programme.title: 花心夢裏人
programme.desc: Fat Chiu and Frankie live together on a temporary basis. During their stay at home, they spend time with one of the home-mate Kwan and consequently build up very close relationship. Sally, who is Frankie's girlfriend, is deeply in romance with Frankie. However, when Pauline, a billionaire turns up, Frankie is crazily attracted by her. He decides to give up Sally. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire..

programme.title: 癲佬正傳
programme.desc: Social worker Fun specializes in counseling psychotics. Writer Yip is inspired by his mission and decides to work with him. One day, Fung is accidentally killed by a patient..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之西域雄獅
programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy..

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May..

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: Tong Park Foo is the top-grade scholar in Suzhou. On a feast day, Tong and his friends go to visit the temple and there, Tong meets Chau Heung for the first time. Tong is shaken at Chau's beauty. He decides to go after her. But Chau's master Mrs. Wah is very angry with Tong's family, how can Tong make Chau Heung his bride.

programme.title: 行運超人
programme.desc: Yip has had bad luck ever since her teenage days. She decides to seek help from famous Feng Shui expert Lai, who discovers that her bad luck is causd by his rival..

programme.title: 七年之癢
programme.desc: Living together for 7 years, Raymond has been faithful to Sylvia. But he is eager to having an affair after being teased by his colleagues. On his business trip to Singapore, he is being used by a charming girl, Siu Hung to smuggle some stolen jewelry. Raymond mistakes for love luck yet he fails to have an affair with Siu Hung before she sneaks away with the jewelry. When he returns home, a diamond ring is found in his luggage and Sylvia takes it as her birthday present. Raymond is so involved with Siu Hung that he decides to take Sylvia on a trip to Singapore to bring back the memory. He requests Sylvia to act if they were first met, but it comes an intruder Money who falls in love with Sylvia at first sight..

programme.title: 重案組
programme.desc: Eddie Chan, a guilt-ridden cop trying to silence his demons from a recent shoot-out who is assigned to rescue kidnapped businessman Huang Yifei. It is a trail that leads Chan and his partner, Hung from Hong Kong to Taipei and back to Hong Kong. As the trail gets warmer, Chan begins to suspect that there are internal forces – including Hung – who seem to working against him..

programme.title: 非常警察
programme.desc: Chicken, Wing and Zita worked in the same police station. Chicken used to make friends with many gangsters; Wing is a pro in computer knowledge; Zita came from a affluent family but devoted to her work. Zita was transferred to Chicken‘s team as their superintendent was termed “The Team in Vain”. Chicken was found to have committed a serious mistake in a mission and was sacked. Zita, as Chicken's girlfriend thought he would reform. However, to her disappointment, Zita discovered Chicken became a procurer in one of her missions. A series of murder was reported, the victims were all teenagers and were killed after they met with a friend from Internet. Wing was assigned to be the bait in this case..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 太子爺出差
programme.desc: Te-pei sets up an Angel's Dust scan but finds himself trapped by Hong Kong police led by Chang. They are ordered to cooperate to crack the narcotize ring and suspect rich Chen as the kingpin. This leads to a Yunan martial arts troupe. Chang falls in love with the troupe's star, Hung. Police raid the troupe but find nothing as Hung has unwittingly taken the narcotics. She wants to smuggle herself to America, only to find herself chased by police and traffickers..

programme.title: 盲女七十二小時
programme.desc: Heung is temporarily blinded by an accident. While her doctor husband leaves Hong Kong for a meeting, an uninvited man arrives at their house. The man teases and tortures Heung, claiming that he is coming to avenge his wife..

programme.title: 夜車
programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience..

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. programme.title: 影人映語 -中產喜劇大師—陳慶嘉
programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

It is a trail that leads Chan and his partner, Hung from Hong Kong to Taipei and back to Hong Kong. As the trail gets warmer, Chan begins to suspect that there are internal forces – including Hung – who seem to working against him..

programme.title: 八星報喜
programme.desc: Fai, the eldest, has met Fong. Long is a guy with many girl-friends. A girl working in a deparment store has become his target. Sung, is a timid artist. Ying comes into his life..

programme.title: 賭神
programme.desc: King of Gambles Gao Jin has been asked by Shangshan of Japan to play a decisive gamble with Devil of Gambles. He finds out Brother Nan in charge of the gamble is playing tricks..

programme.title: 我家有一隻河東獅
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses..

programme.title: 太子爺出差
programme.desc: Te-pei sets up an Angel's Dust scan but finds himself trapped by Hong Kong police led by Chang. They are ordered to cooperate to crack the narcotize ring and suspect rich Chen as the kingpin. This leads to a Yunan martial arts troupe. Chang falls in love with the troupe's star, Hung. Police raid the troupe but find nothing as Hung has unwittingly taken the narcotics. She wants to smuggle herself to America, only to find herself chased by police and traffickers..

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: 君子好逑
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo..

programme.title: 最佳拍檔大顯神通
programme.desc: King Kong was attacked by the robot - Black Knight I which was sent by the Italian Mafia to avenge the capture of White Gloves. He also hired an internationally notorious killer Black Gloves to kill King Kong as well as diamond transfer deal with the underworld. King Kong join forces with the police to capture Black Gloves who sends Black Knight II to attack..

programme.title: 望夫成龍
programme.desc: Shek Kam Shui eloped to the city with his lover Ng Dai Tai. He becomes a diamond sales and was appraised by his senior, Nancy which finally destroys his marriage..

programme.title: 想飛
programme.desc: When Joker meets Ling in a disco one night, he feels she is the perfect model of his dream project 'princess-d'. In reality, however, Ling is the opposite of the perfect image..

programme.title: 精裝追女仔2
programme.desc: As a low-ranking director in Channel 9, Liu Pat turns the station's programmes tremendously vivid. So the boss of Channel 8 orders to get back the audience by hooks or by crooks..

programme.title: 旺角卡門
programme.desc: A low-level trial 'big brother' has a hot-tempered 'littler brother' who can't keep out of trouble, and consequently is in constant need of being bailed out by his protector..

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Buffalo Joe has been a captain on the daily sked for 34 years and his 70th birthday is next week. Joe might have to stop flying if he doesn’t pass his medical and that could spell the end of Buffalo. Before Joe leaves to undergo five days of medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona, he calls two rampies, Sam Storm and Jeff Tapper, into his office to greenlight their DC-3 checkflights. Both Jeff and Sam have slogged away for eight months waiting for this chance. But on flight day, Sam is sick to his stomach from eating bad eggs the night before. Sam is not about to let a bad egg beat him and he helps Jeff prep DC-3, LFR. Just before takeoff, nausea wins—Sam has no choice but to back out and there’s no telling when he’ll get another chance. Jeff, on the other hand, has to overcome the jitters that have haunted him ever since he was in a crash landing earlier in the year. programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Buffalo Joe has been a captain on the daily sked for 34 years and his 70th birthday is next week. Joe might have to stop flying if he doesn’t pass his medical and that could spell the end of Buffalo. Before Joe leaves to undergo five days of medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona, he calls two rampies, Sam Storm and Jeff Tapper, into his office to greenlight their DC-3 checkflights. Both Jeff and Sam have slogged away for eight months waiting for this chance. But on flight day, Sam is sick to his stomach from eating bad eggs the night before. Sam is not about to let a bad egg beat him and he helps Jeff prep DC-3, LFR. Just before takeoff, nausea wins—Sam has no choice but to back out and there’s no telling when he’ll get another chance. Jeff, on the other hand, has to overcome the jitters that have haunted him ever since he was in a crash landing earlier in the year. Mikey, Rod and his family prepare to greet Joe with a birthday cake shaped like a DC-3. At the last minute.

Spurred by a recent crash landing and two engine fires, an audit team from Transport Canada descends on Buffalo Airways. With their long and tumultuous history with Joe, they demand that Buffalo appoint a new “Accountable Executive” within 72 hours, or risk being shut down. But Joe isn’t about to hand over the keys to the kingdom—not even to Rod, his oldest son. Mikey worries that if they don’t meet the deadline, Buffalo Airways could become Buffalo Spare Parts. Transport Canada isn’t the only thing on Joe’s mind; it’s becoming apparent that Joe’s 16-year-old rescue dog, Sophie, is on her last legs. One morning Joe finds Sophie lying under a plane.

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: When Buffalo’s newest Electra, ZFE, lands in Yellowknife with only three functioning engines, mechanic Chuck Adams comes to the rescue to replace a brand-new $29,000 regulator on engine number three. It’s been slow for the airline and delivering a load of building supplies to the RCMP up in Ulukhaktok, NWT, might help keep Buffalo in the air. Spurred by a recent crash landing and two engine fires, an audit team from Transport Canada descends on Buffalo Airways. With their long and tumultuous history with Joe, they demand that Buffalo appoint a new “Accountable Executive” within 72 hours, or risk being shut down. But Joe isn’t about to hand over the keys to the kingdom—not even to Rod, his oldest son. Mikey worries that if they don’t meet the deadline, Buffalo Airways could become Buffalo Spare Parts. Transport Canada isn’t the only thing on Joe’s mind; it’s becoming apparent that Joe’s 16-year-old rescue dog, Sophie, is on her last legs. One morning Joe finds Sophie lying under a plane.

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Buffalo Joe has been a captain on the daily sked for 34 years and his 70th birthday is next week. Joe might have to stop flying if he doesn’t pass his medical and that could spell the end of Buffalo. Before Joe leaves to undergo five days of medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona, he calls two rampies, Sam Storm and Jeff Tapper, into his office to greenlight their DC-3 checkflights. Both Jeff and Sam have slogged away for eight months waiting for this chance. But on flight day, Sam is sick to his stomach from eating bad eggs the night before. Sam is not about to let a bad egg beat him and he helps Jeff prep DC-3, LFR. Just before takeoff, nausea wins—Sam has no choice but to back out and there’s no telling when he’ll get another chance. Jeff, on the other hand, has to overcome the jitters that have haunted him ever since he was in a crash landing earlier in the year. Mikey, Rod and his family prepare to greet Joe with a birthday cake shaped like a DC-3. At the last minute.

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWTNewly minted copilot Jeff Tapper is excited for his first revenue DC-3, but his inexperience shows when he botches the approach and bounces the landing three times, nearly running off the runway. Meanwhile, for new rampie Prefkar Mony to realize his dream of becoming a DC-3 pilot, he needs to first pass the written IATRA test. He’s been studying for months, but on his first attempt, he fails. With the help of pilot/mechanic Chris Staples, Prefkar retakes the test and passes, but his victory celebration is short-lived when he’s blamed for leaving an expensive shipment of medicine marked “Do Not Freeze” in a courier van during a minus 30 weekend. Later, Mikey and Katie decide to find Joe a new dog and choose Muffy, a three-year-old dog from the SPCA who is ready to leave her pups. They bring her back to the hangar for a test drive. Joe brings DC-3 CUE out of retirement to test fly the plane for Buffalo’s summer sked duty and he brings along Jeff—and Muffy—to see if they’re.

programme.title: Sumatra's Last Tigers 第1季
programme.desc: While tiger populations all around the world are crashing, tiger numbers in a remote nature reserve in Sumatra, Indonesia are increasing. Here even man killers are being rehabilitated and released into the wild. The man behind this unique conservation project is Indonesian tycoon, Tomy Winata. Tomy’s ambitious plan now includes releasing a tiger born in captivity into the wild, will it survive and can the experiment transform conservation practices and save the Sumatran tiger.

programme.title: Ice Pilots Nwt 第6季
programme.desc: Mikey talks to a 15-year-old aviation buff in England via Skype, who has discovered that Buffalo’s DC3–WZS–flew on D-Day. This inspires Mikey to do something special for the 70th anniversary. He invites Cory to do a tandem parachute jump and finds out that Cory’s grandfather was a paratrooper at the invasion of Normandy. Meanwhile, Mikey takes mercy on Prefkar, working the ramp in Hay River, and offers him a chance for some pilot training on the morning DC-3 freighter. But when the time comes, Prefkar learns that he’s been bumped for pilot David Alexandre. It gets worse for Prefkar when he’s given another chance and this time the fog rolls in. Prefkar might not stick it out at Buffalo. Mikey’s D-Day plans get even bigger when he contacts the Princess Patricia Canadian Light Infantry, who were part of the Allied airborne forces that dropped behind German lines in 1944. He pitches his plan—a reenactment jump from WZS, an actual D-Day plane. But there’s a hitch: the plane needs to pass in.

She's determined to build her future in the land of fame and fortune.

programme.desc: “Talk With Claire About Great Bay Area” is a bilingual interview program on Shenzhen TV that focuses on in-depth exploration and research. With a global perspective on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, it captures cutting-edge trends in economic and trade exchanges, technological innovation, cultural trends, and more between China and the world. Through on-site research and interviews, the program engages in conversations with leaders from government, business, technology, and cultural sectors. It showcases technological achievements, trends in economic and trade exchanges, and mutual learning in civilization exchanges. Since its inception over two years ago, “Talk With Claire About Great Bay Area” has aired more than a hundred episodes of specialized interviews. The program integrates prominent international figures into the Greater Bay Area, where guests draw from their personal experiences living and working in the area or provide professional perspectives o.

This not only marks the history of this river, but also represent the history of this city, and a reflection on philosophy and our ecosystem.

醫生與你
programme.sub-title: 未消失的白色瘟疫—肺結核
programme.desc: 肺結核（肺癆）在香港已絕跡？大錯特錯！本港每年仍錄得約三千宗新個案。本節目將拆解相關的種種迷思：電視劇中的「咳血」是肺結核的唯一警號嗎？卡介苗真的能保一世平安？「核酸檢測」能否快速無誤地鎖定肺結核病菌？. 嘉賓醫生亦分享辨別肺結核「久咳不癒」與普通感冒的秘訣，解說「潛伏結核」的隱形風險，並解構「全監督治療」（DOTS）在對抗「抗藥性結核病」中的關鍵作用。. 主持：黃秉康醫生、羅鈺文. 嘉賓：何重文醫生（港大醫學院臨床醫學學院內科學系臨床副教授.

programme.title: 動物福利企劃: 阿Meow奇遇記
programme.desc: 陰差陽錯下，女明星明禎跟自己的寵物貓阿Meow靈魂互換了！原來一切都是「寵物精靈」靈靈狗的詭計！. 話說在很久很久以前，靈靈狗只是一隻普通的寵物小狗，可惜遇上一位不懂照顧寵物的主人，令牠一直受苦，最終出走，修煉成「寵物精靈」。有一天，心懷怨念的靈靈狗暗中觀看人間，看見明禎十分愛惜自己的小貓，靈靈狗深信「天下烏鴉一樣黑」，認為她有朝一日也會對阿Meow失去愛心，故此他施展法術，令明禎跟阿Meow的靈魂交換，好讓阿Meow得到「釋放」，一嘗做主人的滋味。. 然而，披上人類外表的阿Meow，一心只想拯救主人，還原各自身份。靈靈狗告訴她，若要破除魔法，必需在一日之內找到足夠數量之「懂得善待動物的人」！為求回復本來面貌，阿Meow在靈靈狗神出鬼沒的監視下，勇敢踏上征途了！. 行動時，本是貓咪的阿Meow每當遇到吸引小貓的東西時，便會忍不住露出貓的反應；同樣，靈靈狗亦會不時受環境影響，露出小狗的神態，鬧出許多驚險與笑話.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 唐詠然Apple是一位先天聽障的本地插畫家，在無聲世界中以色彩與線條尋回屬於自己的「聲音」。她主修多項設計，喜愛創作色彩繽紛的插畫及校園壁畫，從日常生活與社區細節中汲取靈感。居於大埔宏福苑三十年的家在火災中化為灰燼，畫具與多年心血盡毀，所幸家人與她及時逃生。獲善心人捐贈畫具後，Apple選擇以創作回應，她用畫筆療癒別人，也療癒自己，見證在失去與重建之間，堅持與愛從未熄滅。今集主持吳祉昊Macro會和Apple分享。. 同樣住在大埔宏福苑是八十七歲周婆婆，她有弱聽，需要戴助聽器。大火當日匆忙逃生，助聽器亦沒帶走，有機構透過社工知悉情況後，短時間內替她重配助聽器。因為中風而要坐輪椅的陳逸倫住在宏福苑數十年，火災後他要搬離大埔，覆診令他舟車勞動，有機構復康車提供協助.

programme.title: 民生美食關注組
programme.desc: 主持 Brian 與Vicky將會帶大家走進全港最大規模的電影場景展「九龍城寨光影之旅」，重現七記冰室、龍城髮廊等經典場景，更透過氣味與聲效帶你瞬間重回80年代。除了懷舊打卡，兩人還會展開一場美食與回憶之行：由旺角泰國街頭小食到深水埗玩具街的童年回憶，最後再到西九龍中心掃街，帶你玩轉香港最地道的舊城風情.

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.desc: Donovan終得知姐姐Maria因情傷與愧疚而自盡的真相。在Pam的陪伴下，他逐漸接受現實，並希望與她同居，卻遭Pam因外公保守觀念而猶豫。此時，達小姐的報復升級：她設局讓Donovan拍攝受辱廣告，更栽贓Pam偷竊，使其被警方帶走。目睹愛人受辱，Donovan在盛怒衝突後，為保護Pam免受進一步傷害，忍痛提出分手。兩人的關係在對抗外界惡意時，迎來了最痛的暫停.

programme.title: 時事摘錄

programme.title: 藝坊
programme.sub-title: Fong Ka-sin and her "Button Playground" & in the studio: KaJeng Wong
programme.desc: Creativity can be the talent to create something entirely new. It can also be the ability to present ordinary things in an extraordinary way. Local artist Fong Ka-sin, who is a computer programmer by profession, reimagined and reinterpreted buttons that we see and touch daily, and turned them into thought-provoking interactive installations. . In the studio:. Local pianist and conductor KaJeng Wong's Music Lab founded the Atlas Ensemble last year. This April, they are presenting all five of Beethoven’s concertos across two concerts. It's a rarely attempted feat that highlights Beethoven’s virtuosity while celebrating diversity of interpretation. KaJeng Wong is in the studio to share more about the concerts and his upcoming projects. [Schumann's Impromptu.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: Zero Emission. The government has been actively promoting green transportation and has implemented a series of measures to reduce carbon emissions in the transport sector, such as offering tax incentives for electric vehicles, formulating the Strategy of Hydrogen Development in Hong Kong, launching the New Energy Transport Fund, and introducing the Electric Mobility Devices Trial Set. However, the promotion process still faces challenges, including insufficient charging facilities, higher costs, and limitations in technology and infrastructure. . Few years ago, the government unveiled the Hong Kong Climate Action Plan 2050, aiming to achieve zero vehicle emissions and a carbon-neutral transport sector by 2050 through measures such as promoting vehicle electrification and developing new energy transport solutions. Currently, greenhouse gas emissions from transportation remain the second-largest source, accounting for nearly 20% of Hong Kong's total emissions. Is achieving zero vehicle emissions by 2050 an impossible mission.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 《非常老撾菜》帶觀眾走進香港罕見的老撾飲食世界，探索這片金三角樞紐的獨特風味。主持Andy Dark親身品嚐「是冧彈雞見求」等龍坡邦菜式，揭開老撾菜的秘密，當中還有四色糯米飯，以及介紹以蘇木、蜜蒙花染色的藥膳文化。老闆娘更親自教授立求炸飯的煮法及三指抓飯的傳統吃法，展現老撾菜脆酸辣甜的層次口感。節目見證餐廳轉型排檔外賣。燈光雖滅，食物香氣猶在，讓老撾味道滲入城市日常，激發更多人對這神秘菜系的興趣.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 一位劍客正在躲避仇人的追殺，只見他俯下身來，耳朵緊貼地面，判斷着敵人的位置和距離。這樣的絕技絕非小說家的杜撰，在北宋沈括的科學著作《夢溪筆談》中有這樣的記載：“古法以牛革為矢服，臥則以為枕，取其中虛，附地枕之，數里內有人馬聲，則皆聞之。這就是伏地聽聲.

programme.title: 典故裏的科學 第二季
programme.desc: 諸葛亮是三國蜀漢丞相，被譽為睿才。但是在一種古代防護裝備面前，他也曾吃過苦頭。《三國演義》中，孟獲請來南蠻族的藤甲軍隊。特製藤甲刀槍不入，遇水不沉，輕便靈活，藤甲軍可謂水陸無敵。那麼，《三國演義》中「刀槍不入」的藤甲衣真的存在嗎？科學求證人高澤民將帶大家一探究竟.

programme.title: 盛事傳城
programme.desc: 作為香港藝術周的重點盛事，第十一屆藝術中環展會將匯聚 100 多間革新畫廊，並帶來為期五天的一系列表演、藝術裝置、影像藝術及講座等精彩節目.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: “牡丹蕎麥”有強烈香氣與味道，深得大眾歡心，而產量不多，因為也被稱為“幻影蕎麥”。我們會參觀一下整個製作過程.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 在一場雪球大戰中，佩佩和德仔被奧圖的徽章催眠了。迪迪和小特能否找到方法拯救他們的朋友呢.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 迪迪假裝自己肚子痛得厲害，朋友們憂心忡忡，決定帶她去找尊尼。然而，尊尼並沒有被她騙到，更想出辦法令她不再裝病.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 佩佩遇見了奧圖手下一隻壞脾氣的海鸚皮夫，但出乎意料的是，這兩隻海鸚之間竟然擦出了愛火花.

programme.title: 恐龍萌遊記
programme.desc: 小米因未能得到超強光手電筒而沮喪，小麥提議回到史前時代。大家想組建樂團但沒有樂器，小麥敲打風樹果實，引來三葉蟲，沙沙羅嚇跑它們。最後，大家用自然聲音創造樂器，小米回家後製作出超強光手電筒.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 看到莎莎失控出走，一家人終於去找莎莎，沒想到一出門卻被子龍用神力丟進垃圾桶。為求真相眾人回家中，可還沒等搞清狀況幾人又被子龍丟進垃圾桶。眾人設計控制子龍觀看莎莎的記憶，得知莎莎的煩惱，最後在家人們齊心協力下莎莎恢復記憶，一家人也懂得彼此體諒.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在阿根廷北部，人們正每天努力保護蜜蜂，應對近五十年來觀察到的令人不安的變化，而這些變化最近更為加劇.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在尼泊爾，採集蜂蜜是一項危險的任務，但對村民來說卻是珍貴的資源。每年，當遷徙的巨型蜜蜂——喜馬拉雅崖蜂（Apis Dorsata）抵達他們的土地時，一些被選中的勇士便出發，冒著生命危險，收穫這種巨蜂所產的苦蜜。這些探險行動通常持續數日，並伴隨著向森林和懸崖之靈祈禱的儀式，以幫助減少因這種世界上最危險蜜蜂蜇刺而引發的意外事故.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: A wartime bomb was found at a Quarry Bay construction site, forcing the evacuation of 6,000 people from 18 nearby buildings. Police Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD), founded in 1972, handled the case with advanced robots and strict specialist training. With post-pandemic construction projects resuming, the risk of unstable wartime bombs has risen. The government has boosted EOD funding and international cooperation. “ Hong Kong Connection” will reveal exclusive details from the experts’ inspection.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 公共遊樂空間改造計劃
programme.desc: 為提升公共遊樂空間的創意、趣味和共融性，同時滿足巿民對公共遊樂空間的需要，康文署轄下超過 170 個公共遊樂空間開展改造計劃。自二零二零年起，各區已陸續開展共116個改造工程項目，其中11個項目已完成並開放予公眾使用，成為滿足兒童需求、激發潛能的「兒童友好」空間.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: By transforming sunlight, wind and river currents of our homeland into green energy to power our future, homes are lit up by the golden rays of deserts and factories are run on green power. When the massive “Qihang” wind turbines spin to capture the force of nature; When zero-carbon factories operate efficiently in the dark, we can see that clean energy is reshaping the genes of Chinese products.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：葉國華踩到地雷
programme.desc: 肖豔秋到醫院看望賀紅玲的母親，她拿出肖春生寄來的錢，賀紅玲沒有收下。肖春生知道後心裏很不是滋味。錢阿毛提醒肖春生，賀紅玲很可能會現實地拋棄。賀紅玲的媽媽也重申貧賤夫妻百事哀。邊境出現摩擦，部隊進入了備戰狀態。作戰時，葉國華在去找肖春生的路上踩到地雷.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第十九集：肖春生腿受傷，站不起來了
programme.desc: 肖春生為救葉國華，犧牲自己，被送進手術室。肖春生醒來後立馬給姐姐肖豔秋打電話報平安。醫生告訴肖春生他的腿站不起來了，曉梅覺得北京應該可以為肖春生做手術。肖春生心裏難受。葉國華沉浸讚美中，搶了肖春生的功。賀紅玲看著肖春生坐在輪椅上的樣子忍不住哭了起來.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 香港開埠之初，鄉村書室與私塾是孩童啟蒙的搖籃，在四書五經中識字明理。隨著西式學校與教會學堂相繼創辦，中西教育傳統在這片土地碰撞交融，並存共生。本集與大家一同窺探香港早期教育面貌，並細說傳統私塾如何在西潮衝擊下逐步蛻變，奠定日後教育體制的根基。. 主持:. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授). 吳海傑(香港大學法律學院教授及副院長(研究).

programme.title: 演藝盛薈：亞洲青年管弦樂團慶祝35週年音樂之旅
programme.sub-title: 亞洲青年管弦樂團慶祝35週年音樂之旅 (第二集)
programme.desc: 來自10個地區的98位亞洲青年管弦樂團(AYO)青年音樂家，完成13場巡演後載譽歸來，在香港大會堂呈獻兩場精彩絕倫的音樂會，為樂團35週年慶典寫上圓滿的句點。. 本場音樂會曲目. 蕭士塔高維奇:《慶典》序曲. Shostakovich: Festive Overture. 柴可夫斯基:小提琴協奏曲. Tchaikovsky: Violin Concerto. 白遼士:《幻想交響曲》. Berlioz: Symphonie Fantastique. 指揮. 賈德·比格米尼 Jader Bignamini. 小提琴獨奏. 謝爾蓋·克里洛夫 Sergej Krylov. 演出. 亞洲青年管弦樂團 Asian Youth Orchestra.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: Harry 哥哥最近化身神探Harry，專門到不同學校為小鄰居排難解紛。第一集就到大埔浸信會公立學校幫助小鄰居俊仔！. 俊仔滿腔熱血，擁有一顆樂於助人的心，發夢都想做班長。誰知他的偉大抱負換來的卻是同學們反對！理由竟然是：「你又不是模範生，憑什麼選班長？」難道真的要科科考第一，才有資格成為候選人？俊仔的「班長夢」難道就此幻滅？. 不過，貓頭鷹博士為大家拆解《基本法》第二十六條，解決大家的疑惑！今集就與Harry 哥哥一同走入大埔浸信會公立學校，踏上一個關乎夢想、規則與公平的旅程！. 《基本法》第二十六條：. 香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 位于南大屿山的大东山，有海拔869米高，是香港第三高的山。每年秋天时分芒草盛开，是游人登山的旺季。. 但除了芒草之外，山上还有各种有趣又珍稀的植物，今次由专家带领，引导主持寻找那些平日被忽略的植物。. 为了在大东山上看日出，主持决定在位于南大屿郊野公园内的南山营地扎营，凌晨再出发登顶，决心要在大东山上捕捉旭日东升的景象.

programme.title: 藝坊星期天
programme.sub-title: 方嘉善與按鈕遊戲；現場表演：黃家正
programme.desc: 本地藝術家方嘉善本身是程式設計員，她將普通尋常事物以非一般方式呈現，將你和我每日見到、按過無數次的按鈕，結合編程技術，變成令人思考的裝置藝術，挑戰一般人嘅刻板認知。準備好了嗎？按下按鈕，開始《按鈕遊戲》！. 現場表演：. 鋼琴家與指揮黃家正的Music Lab去年成立鼎奏樂團，在四月的兩場音樂會，他們將罕有地一次過演出貝多芬五首鋼琴協奏曲，今集黃家正將介紹音樂會的理念和將來的企劃。. [舒伯特即興曲.

programme.title: 體壇無界限
programme.desc: 今集繼續有NBL全國男子籃球聯賽、港超聯、西甲籃等賽事的精華，另外更有學界田徑的精彩片段.

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 發展局綠化、園境及樹木管理組已更新《樹木園境地圖》2025年增訂版，其中《九龍東》部份，觀塘區新增了多個新綠化景點，包括茶果嶺海濱公園、翠屏河畔長廊等，而《新界》部份，塱原自然生態公園亦完成建設工程，成為本港首個以農耕活動保育自然生態的主題濕地.

programme.title: 優遊記
programme.desc: 【盲盒旅行團】盲盒登山遊. Alice 第一次接受盲盒挑戰！天都未光，究竟要去邊度？. 今次她跟隨毅行教室的 KK Sir 與金齡班出發，路線約 12 公里，最高爬升為408 米的大枕蓋。行程中除了山徑風光，還欣賞到盛放的吊鐘花。. 平日少做運動的 Alice，能否完成這趟旅程？跟着 KK Sir 的叮嚀：「上樓級，唔好急，做好你嘅深呼吸」，一齊出發啦！. 【都市漫遊】跑山遊香港. 「難又拍下、易又拍下」是隊長Captain VL拍片的口頭禪，相信亦是他的宗旨。. 隊長由原本一名熱愛行山跑步的跑友，六年前開始拍片分享行山同郊遊資訊、參加越野跑比賽，再變身成為越野跑比賽的搞手，希望在香港推廣這項運動。. 今集交由隊長用自己雙腳，帶我們用雙眼，感受香港山徑之美～. 【旅遊達人同你傾】亞美尼亞——解開高加索的千年密碼. 主持：李凱翹 Kay. 嘉賓主持：深度遊專家 Jerry.

programme.title: 政正關你事

programme.title: 周末大電影：電影狂
programme.desc: 新手爸爸花掉工資購買攝影機，原是為了記錄初生女兒成長點滴。廠長因利乘便，找他幫工廠拍攝銀禧花絮。他愈拍愈投入，竟意外獲獎，更積極自學實踐夢想，矢志成為業餘電影人。神魂顛倒迷上電影，竟不知不覺冷落妻兒。以鏡頭捕捉真實，卻必須面對紀錄片倫理和審查關卡.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 樂壇小花詹天文(Windy) 2021年參加選秀節目出道，憑着紮實的唱功而獲得樂迷的支持。近年，工作、學業兩忙的詹天文，到底如何安排時間？想知道就千萬別錯過《港樂．講樂》！. 主持. 崔潔彤. 黎展峯. 歌曲：. 《在十字路口告別》. 《一切都是有原因的》. 《我需要哭.

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.sub-title: 麥騫譽 : 機械真漢子
programme.desc: 麥騫譽(Mark)，香港著名機器人企業家、2024年香港十大傑出青年，從小便熱愛機械人動畫，啟發自己長大後投身機械人科研和航天科技事業，被譽為「港版鐵甲奇俠」與5G仿生機器人之父。Mark 希望透過自己和團隊研發的前沿機械人科技，放進不同的生態環境中，提升其生產力和效率，例如是醫療領域中，機械人的投入和應用，可以減低前線醫護人員面對的醫療風險。. Mark亦身為國際宇航科技創新組織祕書長，他希望全世界能和平利用太空技術，達至人類命運共同體，一同生活在一個更加先進、更加和平的世界.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: A wartime bomb was found at a Quarry Bay construction site, forcing the evacuation of 6,000 people from 18 nearby buildings. Police Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD), founded in 1972, handled the case with advanced robots and strict specialist training. With post-pandemic construction projects resuming, the risk of unstable wartime bombs has risen. The government has boosted EOD funding and international cooperation. “ Hong Kong Connection” will reveal exclusive details from the experts’ inspection.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: By transforming sunlight, wind and river currents of our homeland into green energy to power our future, homes are lit up by the golden rays of deserts and factories are run on green power. When the massive “Qihang” wind turbines spin to capture the force of nature; When zero-carbon factories operate efficiently in the dark, we can see that clean energy is reshaping the genes of Chinese products.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在阿根廷北部，人們正每天努力保護蜜蜂，應對近五十年來觀察到的令人不安的變化，而這些變化最近更為加劇.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在尼泊爾，採集蜂蜜是一項危險的任務，但對村民來說卻是珍貴的資源。每年，當遷徙的巨型蜜蜂——喜馬拉雅崖蜂（Apis Dorsata）抵達他們的土地時，一些被選中的勇士便出發，冒著生命危險，收穫這種巨蜂所產的苦蜜。這些探險行動通常持續數日，並伴隨著向森林和懸崖之靈祈禱的儀式，以幫助減少因這種世界上最危險蜜蜂蜇刺而引發的意外事故.

programme.title: 不就是拔河麼
programme.sub-title: 第十七集: 找到了繩感
programme.desc: 周瞳找來全國女子拔河冠軍隊伍與明承大的操練，眾人叫苦不迭。教練對眾人嚴格至極，言語奚落如針。在暴雨中，郭炎率隊友攔下了要離開的女子隊的大巴，在這過程中，第一次眾人一同進入繩感空間.
